title: Bound-Signed Repeat-Key Move-Ordering Mediation Anatomy, Node-Visit/Cutoff Divergence Localization, Patch-Contrast Regression Survival & Minimal TT Diagnostic Surface

authority.rule: P11 conditions on the prospectively frozen P10 replicated skeleton. It may localize downstream search mechanisms and patch survival, but it cannot count inherited P10 positives as a new independent replication.

frozen_parent_domain.eligible_parent_records: all and only P10 ROOT_CHANGE records in either replicated A0 archetype

mediation.target: exact inherited MOVE_ORDER_SEED address recovered by re-cataloguing the pinned P10 world and matching the inherited event_id
mediation.node_identity_ceiling: Private within-trace TT full-key equality is used only to count/reconcile search-event visitation; raw keys are never emitted.
mediation.research_proxy_ceiling: same-node multiwindow revisit is a PVS/re-search proxy, not a complete search-call log.
mediation.candidate_mediator_rule: After exact T-only replay, choose the first post-target divergent CUTOFF event when available; otherwise the first divergent MOVE_ORDER_SEED event; otherwise the first divergent TT semantic event. Convert it to the frozen P34 Q3 quotient cell.
interventions: M_ONLY removal of the selected P34-Q3 mediator class with target intact
T_PLUS_M exact target removal plus selected mediator-class removal

interpretation.OBSERVED_PATH_DIVERGENCE: trace observables diverge but the coarse mediator class does not independently reproduce the target root transition
interpretation.MEDIATOR_CLASS_CAUSAL_ALIGNMENT: M_ONLY independently produces the same root move as T_ONLY and T_PLUS_M does not contradict that transition
interpretation.MEDIATOR_CLASS_INTERACTION_REDIRECT: M_ONLY or T_PLUS_M produces a distinct third root move or reverses the target transition
interpretation.NO_POST_TARGET_MEDIATOR_CANDIDATE: no frozen candidate class is available

mediation.instrumentation_repair_rule: A run that restricts the baseline/T_ONLY observation trace to MOVE_ORDER only is implementation-invalid for the cutoff-localization claim and contributes no authoritative P11 mediation verdict.

patch_contrast.patch_semantics: During measurement search only, suppress MOVE_ORDER_SEED when MAIN, ply=1, depth=5..8, the same full key has appeared previously in the measurement trace with the same TT move, and the event bound matches the selected sign.
patch_contrast.regression_bank: P10 sealed seven-case P9 engineering witness bank plus present matched controls

implementation_roles.C_or_Cpp: engine-native repeat-key/same-move bound-signed behavioral patch inside the existing P34 semantic-use wrapper
implementation_roles.Python: parent recovery, exact replay, trace visitation/cutoff anatomy, mediator-class interventions, patch regression court

stop_rule: Do not split or retune the P10 A0 archetypes.
If an inherited event cannot be recovered by event_id from the re-catalogued pinned world, classify drift and do not substitute another event.
Do not call trace association mediation without M_ONLY intervention support.
Do not treat patch regression outcomes as fresh chess-science replication.
Close after the frozen 17-witness anatomy and seven-case patch bank are adjudicated.
Authoritative mediation closure requires an ALL-class observation trace with at least one observed CUTOFF event across the frozen witness universe.
claim_ceiling: P11 is conditional on P10's late-opening replicated skeleton and does not independently establish its prevalence.
Private full-key equality is an intra-trace technical locator only.
P34-Q3 mediator removal is a coarse class intervention, not an identified natural indirect effect.
The repeat-key behavioral patch is a deliberately bounded developer patch, not a playing-strength recommendation.
No Elo, best-move correctness, human strategic intent, or universal engine law is authorized.
